g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud IoT telemetry with MQTT brokers, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Bigtable and BigQuery

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: Line sensors report to the factory's edge gateway
which connects over MQTT with TLS and a device certificate from CA Service
A passthrough network load balancer spreads connections over MQTT brokers in two zones
The brokers bridge every message to Pub/Sub
A streaming Dataflow job reads the subscription and cleans the readings
writes them to Bigtable keyed by machine and time
and to BigQuery, where plant engineers chart them in Looker
Dataflow publishes readings outside each machine's normal range
A push subscription sends them to the maintenance service on Cloud Run
which opens a work order in Firestore
and pages the on-call engineer through Cloud NAT
